transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. 

Basically, what made me come in is that for the past year or so, I've been having a lot of trouble staying on track. It's like the smallest thing—a phone buzz, somebody just walking past my office, or... I don't know, even a random thought popping into my head about my in-laws—it just completely pulls me off what I’m doing before I can even stop it.
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Yeah, looking back, this was definitely an issue when I was a kid, too. I remember teachers were always moving my seat around. Mostly it was because I talked way too much, or I'd just get up and walk around without asking. I also had a bad habit of blurting things out before they even finished asking a question.
Are these focus problems causing noticeable trouble with your work?

I mean, I’m still keeping up overall. I manage to get the job done. But... yeah, it is starting to cause some issues. I can tell it's costing me patience from people at work, especially when meetings or mentoring conversations just don’t go the way they should because I get sidetracked. And honestly, it's not just work. It's costing me some trust at home, too, when family plans end up getting messed up for the same reasons.
Since childhood, have these focus problems been present pretty consistently throughout your life?

I'm honestly not sure if it's been there consistently the whole time. I mean, I know it was a problem back in school, and obviously it's an issue for me right now, but... I haven't really kept track of whether it was happening every single year in between. I just haven't really thought about it like that.
Do you spend a lot of your day worrying excessively about different things?
No, not really. I mean, I have normal stress and plenty to get done, but... no, I don't spend my day worrying excessively about things. That hasn't really been an issue for me.
Has your trouble with focus gotten noticeably worse compared with your usual baseline over the past year?

No, I wouldn't say it's gotten worse recently. It feels pretty much the same as it usually does. I mean, it's always been a bit of a struggle for me, but there hasn't been some big drop-off or sudden change in the last year or anything. It's just my normal baseline.
